hollandQuestions.text: What kind of problems do you most enjoy solving?

answers.text: Mechanical or physical problems — how things work  [R]
Intellectual puzzles — why things happen  [I]
Creative challenges — how to express an idea  [A]
Human problems — how to help or support people  [S]
Strategic problems — how to win or persuade  [E]
Process problems — how to organize or improve efficiency  [C]

hollandQuestions.text: In a group project, which role do you naturally take on?

answers.text: The one who builds or makes things work  [R]
The one who researches and analyzes  [I]

The one who organizes tasks and deadlines  [C]
